_doc: Hand-maintained policy (DESIGN §A3c, §A6). Each key is ONE entry; changing it is the whole change.
_env_value_rule_doc: How the pinned CLIs' own `@env:VAR` turns the variable into the secret: `verbatim` (mnemonic 0.104.0, ms 0.19.1, measured) or `strip-one-trailing-newline` (strip exactly one trailing \n or \r\n; the expected F-687 rule). The GUI applies it to a resolved @env:VAR value to get the TARGET bytes.
_private_channels_on_doc: OSes whose Run path uses the private-channel planner. Every other OS uses the interim path: C1-resolved bytes on argv + --allow-argv-secret. An OS may be listed ONLY if a CI job on that OS runs the real-binary tests (T2, T3', T7); test_plan.py's os_gate checks the workflows.
_env_name_rule_doc: The CLI's own rule (mnemonic-toolkit env_sentinel.rs is_valid_posix_env_var_name).
